verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents only programmable building blocks: messaging and voice APIs, Sync for real-time data, an event stream, and persistent memory for agents. None of it shows a product feature that threads calls and texts under a contact with team-visible notes and history. A developer could build this from those primitives, but that earns no credit, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a sales lead, calls and texts thread under a contact with notes and history the whole team sees
